message.content: According to the dialogue, Thane Chambers expresses his favorite scene with Yennefer in the game as the one where Geralt is looking for Yennefer in the early part of the game. He describes this scene as "brilliantly done" in terms of how it intertwines their past and present, setting the stage for their complex relationship. This suggests that the scene involves Geralt searching for Yennefer, likely after she has left him in the beginning of the game, and the interaction likely highlights the emotional and narrative importance of their relationship.
